predecessors.name: Nan Sarunai
predecessors.text: the Tabalong valley round Amuntai and Tanjung, 'centered in present-day North Hulu Sungai Regency'

successors.name: Sultanate of Banjar
successors.text: South Kalimantan: Negara Daha on the Negara River, the land Raden Samudra's Banjar replaced (as the sultanate-of-banjar dossier draws it)

ledger.x: 1380: Ampu Jatmika founds Negara Dipa at Amuntai.
1478: Sekarsungsang moves the capital and the kingdom becomes Negara Daha.
1478: the capital moves from Amuntai to Muara Hulak (port Muara Bahan).
1478: Daha's territory spreads over South Kalimantan and Kotawaringin.
1526: Raden Samudra's Banjar replaces Negara Daha.
1526: Negara Daha ends in the Banjar Sultanate.

wars.name: Daha succession war and Demak's intervention
wars.outcome: Prince Samudera, who fled after the succession dispute, 'sought help from the Demak Sultanate' and 'regained the throne and established the Banjar kingdom'.

certainty.note: Hikayat Banjar traditions; no frontier on either page.
